transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I suppose what brings me in is... I just don't have the push I used to have. I used to go to choir, do my quilting, and visit folks. But lately, most days I just sit at home with the TV on low. I know people are expecting me to be there, but I just can't seem to get going anymore.
Do you still enjoy the activities you used to do, like choir and quilting, when you do manage to do them?
I don't really know. I haven't actually made it to choir or picked up my quilting in a good long while, so... I couldn't tell you if I still like them. I just don't have the energy to try.
Do you still find pleasure in the things you do?

I'm not really sure how to answer that. Like I said, I mostly just sit with the TV on these days. It passes the time, I guess... but I wouldn't say I feel much pleasure from it. I just don't feel much of anything about it either way.
Have you been having any thoughts about hurting yourself or wishing you were dead?
No, I haven't. I mean, I don't have the energy for much, but... no, I haven't thought about anything like that. I don't want to hurt myself or anything. I just... I just sit.
Have you been having any trouble sleeping?

No, I haven't had any trouble with that. I sleep pretty well, mostly. I mean, I might doze off in my chair during the day since I'm just sitting there with the TV on, but... no, at night I sleep just fine.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite lately?
No, my appetite is about the same. I eat when I'm supposed to, I guess. I don't really think about it much, but I'm not eating any more or less than usual. Just regular meals.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Well, it's been a while now. I guess... this has been building up since I retired from the school office. That was a little over two years ago. It just sort of started then and hasn't really stopped.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than you used to, or having trouble sitting still?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I'm getting older, so I might not be as fast as I used to be, but... no, I move around just fine. And I definitely don't have any trouble sitting still. Like I said, I sit in my chair most of the day anyway, so... sitting still isn't a problem for me at all.
Have you been feeling worthless or guilty about anything lately?

No, I don't think so. I mean... I don't have anything to feel guilty about, really. I haven't done anything wrong. And worthless... no, I don't feel that way. I just live my life quiet-like since I retired, so... no, nothing like that.
Have you noticed any change in your weight lately?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I don't really step on the scale much, but... my clothes all still fit me the same as they always have. So, I think my weight has stayed pretty much the same.
Do you feel like you're doing things more slowly than you used to, even when you do get up and do something?

No, I don't think so. I mean, like I mentioned a minute ago, I know I'm getting older, so maybe I'm a little slower than when I was in my twenties... but day to day? No. When I get up to make a cup of coffee or wash a dish, I just do it. I haven't noticed it taking me any longer than it usually does.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
No, I don't feel sad. I mean... I have my days, like anyone else, I suppose. But most of the time? No, I'm just... fine. I don't sit around feeling down or anything like that.
Do you think you've lost interest in things you used to care about?

Well, yes, actually. That's... that's kind of what brings me in. I just don't have the push I used to have for things. Like choir, or my quilting, or even just visiting folks. Most days, I just sit at home with the TV on low. I know people are expecting me, but I just... I don't go. I don't seem to care to.
Do you often feel tired?

No, not really. I mean... I sleep alright most nights, so my body isn't worn out or anything. It's not that I'm physically tired. Like I was just saying, it's more that I just don't have the urge to get up and go. But no, I wouldn't say I feel tired.
Do you feel like you're resting or doing nothing more often than you used to, not because you want to, but because you just can't seem to get started on anything?

Well... no, I wouldn't put it that way. It's not that I'm trying to do things and just can't get started. 

Like I was saying, I just don't have the interest. I sit with the TV on because I'm fine just sitting there. It's not like I want to be doing my quilting and I'm stuck in the chair, unable to move. I just... I look at it and I don't care to do it. So I don't.
Do you ever find yourself looking forward to things that are coming up?

No, I don't. I guess it just goes back to what I was saying a minute ago. That's really the whole reason I came in... I just don't have that push anymore. Even when I know something is on the calendar, like choir or visiting folks, and I know they're expecting me to be there... I don't get excited for it. I don't look forward to it at all. I just end up staying home with the TV on low.
Do you feel like you're fidgety or restless, or do you have an inner feeling of jitteriness?
No, I don't feel jittery or restless. I'm actually pretty still most of the time, just sitting in my chair. I don't feel fidgety at all.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
No, I haven't. I mean, I don't really get on a scale or anything, but... my clothes all fit exactly the same. So I haven't noticed losing any weight.
Do you feel like you're moving or reacting more slowly than other people around you?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I'm not in any rush, but I don't feel like I'm moving slower than anyone else. I just take my time getting up or walking to the kitchen. I haven't noticed being unusually slow.
Do you feel unhappy or down most of the time?
No, I wouldn't say I feel unhappy or down. I mean, I have my days like anyone else, but most of the time I feel perfectly fine. I'm just living my life, you know? I don't feel sad or depressed.
